result.claim: Only this bounded selection; no native aggregate or release qualification.

scope: No production, test, manifest or authority-contract changes. The unchanged browser diagnostic retains 1,440 raw timings, twelve p95 rows and four mapped CPU profiles, with cold-reopen checks. Card p95 is 15.0/16.4 ms desktop and 73.0/73.9 ms CPU-4x Android in the two blocks. The separate application budget gate remains failed at its last 15.2/69.4 ms observation. Across separate 60-key profiles, stack copying uses 157.8/738.2 ms desktop/Android, alongside 166.4/752.5 ms for the admission draft and 148.2/730.9 ms for the history draft. Nested totals overlap. Native structuredClone is not isolated from inline callback work. Nine controlled Node strata retain all 360 measured forks: at 1,000 undo groups, full history medians are 1.848, 8.802 and 559.527 ms with zero, one and 100 selection targets; corresponding document medians are 1.153, 1.180 and 1.348 ms. Fixed document state within pairs and metadata strata helps localize copying cost; increasing stratum order, dependent host/JIT/GC observations, stress-only target layout and zero redo/redone coverage limit inference. The prospective protocol, raw profiles/mapped nodes, probe, all samples, analysis and source-map hashes are retained; complete generated maps remain in the raw run. No application speedup or budget closure is claimed. The next bounded attempt preserves deep isolation and both drafts while specializing known selection metadata, with arbitrary metadata falling back to the existing clone. The personal app, server and deployment remain untouched.
